title: George S NDE 1074
content:
The first time I was in a boarding school in Pennsylvania. Developed pneumonia and was placed in an unheated room. Had a fever rise to a hundred and seven degrees. I was moved to a hospital. My mother was a nurse there. I had no pulse or breathing, felt my body rise out of my body, and could see everyone doing what they could to bring me back. I was up near the ceiling, could see a long tunnel of light, and approached the end of it, but something made me come back to my body. My mother made them pack my body in ice and I was in a metal tub for three days - when my fever broke and I came back from wherever I was. I have had - unsure of how to describe it - three episodes where I saw windows into the past since then. The second time, I had been beaten by my alcoholic father and knocked into a bathtub of boiling water. I was found at the bottom of the stairs of our house and had lost eighty percent of the blood in my body. I was taken to Walter Reed Army Hospital and pronounced dead with no respiration or pulse. I again saw the light and felt my body leave my body. I came back but it took a year to recover from my injuries. I have seen the ghosts of relatives since then at the time of their death and had panic attacks for thirty years after this incident. As an aside, my mother is somewhat intuitive and has known when family members are ill or have died even when they are thousands of miles away. I have some of that ability, but it is more of a sense of something is wrong and I have to call and ask if anyone is ill - I did not have this before my experiences. I have also had one episode of missing time and cannot account for the half an hour loss.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Something 'made me come back to my body.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two episodes described (1957 and 1964). Second includes OBE and 'saw the light' but no tunnel description.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: First: OBE (near ceiling) → tunnel of light → approached end → forced return. Second: OBE → saw light → return (no tunnel described).
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: OBE and light/tunnel elements occurred in both episodes (tunnel explicitly in first).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Post-NDE: 'three episodes where I saw windows into the past'; 'seen the ghosts of relatives since then at the time of their death'; 'one episode of missing time...half an hour loss.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I had no pulse or breathing, felt my body rise out of my body, and could see everyone doing what they could to bring me back.”
